mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDPC1 (demand) signals an expanding economy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 10.5% triggers a labor market tightening effect, reducing inflationary pressures and prompting positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses above 10.5% (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary policy tightening) and GDPC1 (demand growth) creates a dual signal of economic expansion and policy restraint, predicting positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise concurrently (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS signals reduced monetary accommodation, amplifying market optimism and driving positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: During late-cycle expansion, FEDFUNDS decline does not lead to positive 5-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in INDPRO below 100 (supply contraction) reduces production capacity, increasing demand and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when INDPRO drops below 100 (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in CPIAUCSL (inflation) signal rising price pressures, leading to market uncertainty and negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL's increase does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in FEDFUNDS (monetary tightening) and fall in UNRATE (labor market tightening) creates a dual signal of economic restraint and labor market strength, predicting positive 5-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: monetary tightening and labor market tightening
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a decline in FEDFUNDS signals reduced monetary accommodation, accelerating market recovery and driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: During post-shock recovery, FEDFUNDS decline does not lead to positive 60-day returns (p > 0.05).
